notes.title: Quick Patch 12/31/23
notes.notes:
- Buffed Pink Stuffed Dolphin
- Fixed issue where pink stuffed dolphin could be revived and become sentient
- fixed potential issue with CORE bot's image not loading
- fixed bug in the arcade game "Snipe!" with Killest

notes.title: Neptune Patch!
notes.notes:
- fixed a potential softlock in the surfing competition minigame on Neptune
- fixed a progression issue with the dinner reservation on Neptune
- fixed a progression issue caused by the "Neptune Rock Hopper" arcade game on Neptune
- fixed a potential softlock from talking to Maria in the wrong position on Mars
- other minor adjustments
- added FIL to the game
- removed FIL from the game
- removed player two

notes.title: Update Notes for July 31st, 2023!
notes.notes:
- Fixed various bugs throughout the game
- Balanced certain items, such as the weapons and armor on Uranus
- Removed FIL

notes.title: The Over Achiever Update
notes.notes:
•    Achievements added when you beat a planet and other miscellaneous things 
•    Death Caps and Jup Coops are now escapable 
•    A Variety of Bug Fixes and Balancing Changes
•    Metallic Magicians’ theme less bombastic 
•    Removed FIL
